content: The FDA first approved trastuzumab (Herceptin) for breast cancer on **September 25, 1998**. The approval was hailed as a "biotechnology breakthrough in breast cancer." It was initially approved for the treatment of HER2-overexpressing metastatic breast cancer. Herceptin later received additional approvals, including for adjuvant treatment of HER2-positive node-positive breast cancer (November 2006) and for HER2-positive metastatic stomach cancer (October 2010).
